notes.title: Parliament: First Flight is now live!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="j4pouajyixk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Hey owls![/h2][h3][/h3][p]Yep, you read it right, don't panic...[/p][h1]Parliament: First Flight is now live![/h1][p][/p][p]You can either hit the "[b]Download Demo[/b]" button on the main page, [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662556/6f432729d9596f1962ab6c2cf0d39b4cf7c25d14.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]or[/h2][p][/p][p]Head to the full page for the demo by clicking here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755390/Parliament_First_Flight/" style="button" buttoncolor="#5ba1f1"]Parliament: First Flight Page[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Now you can go and be an owl, eat prey, fight wolves and show that bear who's boss! Technically, they are, even if you win, but you will feel might strong afterwards, we think![/p][p][/p][p]We have so much more to do, but we are so excited to share this demo with you and hear your thoughts! Tell us on Discord, or use the in game feedback button to give us the specific feedback we are looking for.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the game and look forward to you playing.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, owls![/p][p][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662556/8186ca23105e97157d1d554f57681ed166ec2c8a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662556/8186ca23105e97157d1d554f57681ed166ec2c8a.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Parliament: First Flight Comes to Steam!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662556/8186ca23105e97157d1d554f57681ed166ec2c8a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Hi Owls!![/h2][p][/p][p]Welcome to [b]Parliament[/b], the world's first Owl-like! We are so excited to share this game with the world and hear what you think.[/p][p][/p][p]We aren't quite ready to call this a full game yet, but we do want to show you the progress we've made. So, we're excited to announce [b]Parliament: First Flight[/b], which is a demo of our beloved owl game![/p][p][/p][p]In this demo, you will [i]definitely [/i]experience some funny business, bugs, and other unintended things that will pop up during your adventures. But hey, that's why it's a demo! We want to know what you think about the general idea of the game, since we are so early in the process![/p][p][/p][p]Please take some time and fly around, grow stronger and explore! We would be very grateful if you [b]dropped us a wishlist[/b] and hung around until we release the full game later on![/p]
